rawContent: You ain’t seen nothing yet! For all the critics wondering what these peaceful mass #BlackLivesMatter protest will ultimately achieve, take a look at this list. This is what a nationwide 21st century racial justice movement looks like. #TogetherWeCan  https://t.co/347cyE7B5e

⁦@Starbucks⁩ bans employees from wearing anything in support of #BlackLivesMatter but permits #LGBTQ employees to wear #LGBTQ pins & shirts. I guess Human Resources never stopped to consider folks that are both Black & LGBTQ...sigh 🤦🏽‍♂️#DoBetter https://t.co/9D5hjhDpOt

“Policy is being used to penalize workers supporting #BlackLivesMatter at a time when ⁦@amazon⁩, ⁦@WholeFoods⁩ parent, has made several public statements in support of the movement.” Support ⁦@WholeWorkerWFM⁩
#AskYourWholeFoods #DoBetter
 https://t.co/Y90YZca0jt

“All that can save you now is your confrontation w/your own history...which is not your past,but your present.Your history has led you to this moment,& you can only begin to change yourself by looking at what you are doing in the name of your history.”#BLM https://t.co/iHn1M0CDPg

"There's so many layers to Black Lives Matter-ing. It's about reform, it's about justice, it's about generational wealth, it's about fair wages, it goes across the board." Outstanding leadership & powerful demo of making #BLM, ⁦⁦@buyingbackla⁩. https://t.co/6704HljyG1

#Martinez neighbors my hometown in the #BayArea, not far from the 1944 Port Chicago Disaster. Her feeble attempt to erase the power & presence of #BlackLivesMatter mural, a public declaration of the dignity & inherent self-worth of Black lives, dishonors our continued sacrifice.

“If convicted, they could face up to a year in county jail.” Thanks to @ContraCostaDA for swift & decisive action. Over 100 members of the community came together to paint that mural. Two divisive characters attempted to sow hate & division. They won’t win b/c #BlackLivesMatter.

“Some are cautious about what this moment might mean for #AboriginalRights.There is a national reflex of denial & deflection of concerns about discrimination.Many Australians simply don’t see racism as a problem within our institutions.”Sound familiar?#BLM https://t.co/ywfcfQ5jLb
“Police officials talk about the ‘sanctity of life’ as the overarching thread connecting many of the changes.” #BlackLivesMatter #ImagineThat  https://t.co/AuRC1VaB6I

Shame on @LAPDHQ! If we can’t agree this is an EXCESSIVE USE OF FORCE,we have lost our way. I’ve never seen a wheelchair bound disabled person handled,so callously by public servants sworn to protect & serve. @MayorOfLA must hold these officers accountable. Make #BlackLivesMatter
Two words: American hero. We will continue to make #GoodTrouble and make #BlackLivesMatter. Rest in power, @repjohnlewis. https://t.co/PvJoBudMKO

“The donation is part of a $100 million, 10-year pledge that the basketball star made last month to "organizations dedicated to ensuring racial equality, social justice and greater access to education.” Outstanding! Let’s all #BeLikeMike and do our part to make #BlackLivesMatter.

“⁦@oprahmagazine⁩ team say they are amplifying Taylor's story and the fight for justice by erecting 26 billboards across the city. That's one for every year of her life.” #BlackLivesMatter means justice for #BreonnaTaylor. Her life meant something. https://t.co/4XMs4hYRwG

We must speak these words knowing that the day-to-day work to make #BlackLivesMatter means re-examining our assumptions and operating differently. To say Black life has inherent value can only mean Black #LGBTQ lives have inherent value, too. @KamalaHarris gets this. Do you?

“The new generation of mayors, by contrast, impatient with historical constraints, have been more willing to supplement the tools they can use from inside government with the energy from the political movements outside of it.” #BlackLivesMatter #EqualityCantWait #ForThePeople
